trial_allocation.allocation_rationale: Baseline model — fixed defaults, no HPO needed.

XGBoost is highly sensitive to hyperparameters like max_depth, learning_rate, and n_estimators. Given the small dataset (312 samples), it requires careful tuning to find the narrow sweet spot that captures non-linearities without overfitting. 18 trials allow sufficient exploration of the constrained search space.

LightGBM's leaf-wise growth mechanism makes it prone to overfitting on small datasets if num_leaves and max_depth are not tightly controlled. 15 trials provide enough budget to tune its regularization parameters (lambda_l1, lambda_l2) and tree structure constraints.

Random Forest is inherently more robust to overfitting due to bagging and feature subsampling. It requires less aggressive HPO than gradient boosting models, so 10 trials are sufficient to optimize max_depth and min_samples_split for the 42 features.

Elastic Net has a very small search space (primarily alpha and l1_ratio). 7 trials are more than enough to map the convex optimization landscape and find the optimal regularization balance for the 42 features.

parameters.name: n_estimators
parameters.override_rationale: Excessive boosting iterations on a small dataset lead to overfitting, even with early stopping. Capping n_estimators at 200 prevents the model from over-specializing to the training folds.

parameters.name: max_depth
parameters.override_rationale: With only 312 samples, deep trees will severely overfit by memorizing noise. Constraining max_depth to a maximum of 5 forces the model to learn only the most robust, high-level composition-property relationships.

parameters.name: num_leaves
parameters.override_rationale: LightGBM's primary complexity driver is num_leaves. Capping it at 31 (which corresponds roughly to a max_depth of 5) ensures the model remains constrained and generalizes well to the 42 features.

parameters.name: max_depth
parameters.override_rationale: Similar to XGBoost, LightGBM needs strict depth constraints on 312 samples to prevent the leaf-wise growth algorithm from creating overly complex, overfitted trees.

parameters.name: max_depth
parameters.override_rationale: While Random Forest is more robust to overfitting than boosting, allowing unlimited depth on 312 samples with 42 features can still increase variance. Capping at 12 provides enough capacity for non-linear interactions while maintaining stability.
